title: Antitrust laws.
bodyText: No provision of this chapter shall repeal, modify, or supersede, directly or indirectly, any provision of chapter 480.
bodyHtml: [§481G-8]  Antitrust laws.  No provision of this chapter shall repeal, modify, or supersede, directly or indirectly, any provision of chapter 480. [L 1983, c 285, pt of §1]
